# Aaron Barlow

> HPC Software Engineer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory building agentic AI for exascale operations. Talks at CUG, NLIT; projects include myOLCF, Anthologia, Project Cadenza.

- Focus: HPC platform engineering, agentic workflows, performance optimization (e.g. 1320× speedup).
